validity.recommendation: Existence, route, operator, length, capacity and construction-start (2015-08) are all independently confirmed and match GEM exactly. But StartYear1/StartMonth1 = 2017-05 is unsupported and likely wrong: every independent account of this pipeline's commissioning dates the trial-operation start to December 2017 (Dec 5-11, 2017), not May 2017. Recommend changing StartMonth1 to 12 (or blanking the month if precision is uncertain) -- keep StartYear1=2017.
validity.researcher_notes: The sheet's own cited ref (gig.cn journal.do?id=433198...) is dead -- 403 on every fetch attempt (curl, WebFetch, and the existing_ref_checks already logged in wiki_citations/worklist). No gem.wiki page exists for this row either (wiki field empty, and P7673 is absent from wiki_citations.json's harvested pages), so this row had zero working citations going in. Web-search budget for the session was exhausted before I started (200/200), so I worked via WebFetch against DuckDuckGo-HTML search results instead of the WebSearch tool. That surfaced independent corroboration on two separate axes: (1) a Dec 2017 Liuzhou Daily wire story (same underlying story reprinted at tzcjj.liuzhou.gov.cn [Liuzhou govt economic-cooperation portal, dated 2017-12-08], china5e.com [dated 2017-12-11, byline '柳州日报'/Liuzhou Daily], and sohu.com [dated 2017-12-08]) describing a 27km pipeline from a China-Myanmar-pipeline transmission station in Liujiang District to a distribution station in Liunan District, Liuzhou, with a 3.70x10^8 Nm3/yr design capacity (=0.37 bcm/y) and construction start Aug 28, 2015 -- these three all trace to one origin (same wire story, do not count as 2 independent per project rules) but read as credible local-government-adjacent reporting; and (2) a genuinely separate origin, a docin.com-hosted environmental-impact-report listing titled '柳州市广西天然气支线管网项目柳江天然气支线管道工程变更项目' (Liuzhou Guangxi gas branch network project -- Liujiang gas branch pipeline engineering-change project), an EIA filing built by Guangxi Guangtou Natural Gas Pipeline Co., Ltd. (matches GEM's Operator exactly), consultant Guangxi Tainen Engineering Consulting Co., Ltd., uploaded Feb 2020. A related Guangxi Ecological Environment Department official notice (document 桂环函〔2018〕3050号, dated 2018-12-25, re: changes to the Liujiang gas pipeline branch project) turned up in the same search but its host (sthjt.gxzf.gov.cn) was unreachable from this environment (ConnectTimeout/ECONNREFUSED) so I could not fetch and cite it directly -- it is corroborating context only, not a cited ref. Cross-checked against GEM: Length 27.00 km matches exactly; Capacity 0.37 bcm/y matches exactly (370 million Nm3); ConstructionYear/Month 2015-08 matches 'August 28, 2015' exactly; StartLocation/EndLocation (Liujiang District -> Liunan District, both Liuzhou prefecture) match exactly; FuelSource 'Sino-Myanmar Gas Pipeline' matches (pipeline originates at a China-Myanmar-pipeline transmission station); Operator matches the EIA filing's builder. Diameter (335.6mm), Pressure (4.00 MPa) and SegmentCost (61.77M RMB, 2019) are not mentioned in any source I could reach -- unverified but not contradicted, left as-is. No duplicate found against the 43-row roster (no other row shares Liujiang District as an endpoint). Classification (transmission) is consistent with how sibling branch-network rows in this roster are treated. The one real defect: StartYear1/Month1 = 2017-05 has no support anywhere I found, and the only dated evidence for commissioning specifically says December 2017 (trial operation, '进入调试运行阶段', formal production pending downstream completion) -- a 7-month conflict on the month is material, not noise.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Pipeline was reported commissioned (trial operation) in December 2017 and had a formal EIA 'engineering change' filing processed through Feb 2020, both consistent with a long-since-operating branch line -- no evidence of any status change, outage, or decommissioning found in searches (constrained: session WebSearch budget was exhausted, so this relied on WebFetch-driven search-engine queries only; no news dated later than the 2020 EIA filing was found in either direction). No reason to doubt 'operating' -- confirming the recorded status rather than treating it as stale, since it is a long-completed, in-service branch pipeline, not a dormant proposed/shelved project subject to the 2y/4y staleness rules.
